response.answer: Your record supports saying that you route same-hour requests to next-morning slots because a single evening of preparation materially improves your interview performance; you described that preparation as “the entire difference.” You can also say the prior same-hour format was not workable for you. However, the record also notes a new counsel-cleared rapid-brief process that can produce a fact card within twenty minutes and “change [your] answer,” so the rationale supports a preparation-based standard rather than an absolute refusal of every same-hour request.
